content.title: Arvada Urban Renewal Authority
content.summary: The Arvada Urban Renewal Authority (AURA) is an independent entity in Colorado focused on revitalizing designated urban areas to enhance the quality of life in Arvada. Governed by a seven-member volunteer board appointed by the Mayor, AURA collaborates with city officials, private developers, and the community to eliminate blight and implement approved urban renewal plans.
content.body:
The Arvada Urban Renewal Authority's  website can be accessed at [Arvada Urban Renewal Authority](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/).

The Arvada Urban Renewal Authority (AURA) is responsible for revitalizing urban areas designated throughout the community by creating successful, high-quality projects that will help produce a vibrant, cohesive city and enhance the quality of life for the citizens of Arvada.

AURA is an independent body, corporate and politic under the State of Colorado law and governed by a seven member volunteer board appointed by the Mayor and approved by the City Council. The Board works under a common vision dictated by the legally approved urban renewal plan.

Under state law, AURA is charged with assisting the City in eliminating and preventing the occurrence of blight. To carry out this mandate, AURA works in collaboration with elected officials, city administrators, private developers, financing sources, as well as the community.
